name: Wyrmtouched Scion
body:
You stand above other wyrmtouched, a paragon of your race.

Prerequisite(s): Character level 5th, wyrmtouched.

Benefit(s): You gain one of the following racial traits or alternate racial traits from the wyrmtouched race:

Brutal dragoon
Draconic breath weapon
Elevated awareness
Wyrm wings

Special: You can select this feat multiple times, each time selecting a different racial trait.

Special: You cannot select the brutal dragoon racial trait if you have the monstrous growth racial trait.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
